draft.shortGloss: to close; to shut; to turn off
draft.emotion: calm and everyday, firmly securing things for the night
notes: Has an irregular past participle (chiuso) and past historic (chiusi).
For electrical appliances and lights, 'spegnere' is normally used rather than 'chiudere'.

senses.definition: To move a door, window, lid, or similar object so that it is no longer open.

examples.text: Ricordati di chiudere la finestra prima di uscire.
examples.translation: Remember to close the window before going out.
examples.emotion: friendly and practical, giving a helpful reminder

senses.definition: To stop operating a shop, business, or public building for the day or permanently.

examples.text: Il supermercato chiude alle nove di sera.
examples.translation: The supermarket closes at nine in the evening.
examples.emotion: matter-of-fact and informative, stating a simple schedule

senses.definition: To stop the flow of water or gas by turning a tap or valve.

examples.text: Non dimenticare di chiudere il rubinetto dell'acqua.
examples.translation: Don't forget to turn off the water tap.
examples.emotion: instructive and firm, ensuring nothing is wasted

translations.from: Accostare gli battenti di una porta, di una finestra o simili in modo da impedire il passaggio.
translations.to: To move the parts of a door, window, or similar object to block passage.

translations.from: Smettere di far funzionare un apparecchio o interrompere l'erogazione di acqua, gas o luce.
translations.to: To turn off an appliance or stop the supply of a service like water, gas, or electricity.

translations.from: Smettere l'attività di un negozio, di un ufficio o di un'azienda per la giornata o definitivamente.
translations.to: To stop the operations of a business or office, either for the day or permanently.
